_note: Daily Biggest Movers (Mark t613u 2026-10-08). The ONE place that defines the ranking (read by scripts/movers_rank.py) and the CTA tagline (read by scripts/build_site.py and the X card/post maker). Window: the shortest of window_days_preferred for which at least min_valid_shops shops have an exact sales-counter pair ending on the snapshot date. Today the panel reads each shop every 2 days, so 1-day pairs do not exist yet and the window is 2 days; once daily reads exist the page switches to 24h on its own.

rising_list._note: EXACT-1 (Mark 2026-10-08): Rising Shops = shops with <= max_total_sales lifetime sales at the end of the window, ranked by exact sales added over the shop-list window (replaces the scaled 7-day panel list).

niche_list.source: tracker shop category (Etsy category path; niche = its last segment)
niche_list._note: Mark t620u 2026-10-08: daily 'Etsy's fastest-growing niches'. Same clean exact counter pairs as the shop list; niche window = the shortest of window_days_preferred with >= top_n rankable niches. Rankable = >= min_shops shops with clean reads in that window AND the biggest shop <= max_top_shop_share of the niche's sales added. Shops without a category are skipped. Ranked by total sales added (ties: more shops first).

exclude_note: Lowercase Etsy shop names never ranked (e.g. Mark's own shops). None known as of 2026-10-08.
